find_permuted_rows: find all rows in a matrix that are permutations of a given reference row
review_f_gold: review the f_gold function that checks if matrix rows are permutations of a reference row
test_f_gold: test the f_gold function with a matrix and reference row index to find permuted rows
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to return a list of permuted row indices instead of printing them
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold algorithm that uses a set to detect permuted rows in a matrix
